title: Moonlit Breakwater: The Herbalist's Harbor Charter
premise: In a drowned port exposed at the edge of the lunar tide, the herbalist must isolate the cure from hazardous blooms using a woven specimen satchel.
ending: Recover the Harbor Charter and return with the restorative field formula; Night Harbor Guild can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive undertow gate while evading the lighthouse revenant without sacrificing the restorative field formula.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Night Harbor Guild to witness the woven specimen satchel.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to harvest a rare living specimen
